reviews.text:
My dog ​​was born with a brain disorder and frequently suffered seizures. We made the effort to go to the veterinary clinic recommended by the pet shop, even though it was far away, but there wasn't much improvement. After several recommendations from dog-owning friends, we decided to try this clinic.

The consultations are a bit long, but the examinations and explanations are incredibly thorough, and they are very supportive and understanding, which gives us a great sense of reassurance. Now, he only has seizures about once a year, and he's healthy and happy every day.

Thank you so much.
They always give thorough explanations and are able to answer any questions I have, so I keep coming here.

The doctor talked for so long that he couldn't even properly examine my pet. My children were hospitalized, but I wasn't allowed to see them for a long time, and when I finally did, they were in a weakened state. I had them discharged immediately and transferred them to another hospital. I was told that they would have died if they had stayed another day due to dehydration. Some people say that opinions like ours are harassment, but this is something we actually experienced. I pray that your precious family members will not suffer the same fate.
The doctor's examinations are thorough, so they avoid excessive testing. The treatment is also precise, and he cured my persistent diarrhea, so I trust him very much.
This is a trustworthy animal hospital.
We also have a pet hotel.

This was my first time welcoming a cat into my home, and I received excellent care from vaccinations to spaying. It was clear that both the nurses and the head veterinarian genuinely love animals, and I always felt at ease leaving my cat in their care. My beloved cat remained calm throughout, which I believe was due to the love and care of the veterinarian and nurses.

I've since moved and can no longer visit, but thank you so much for everything.

I was also deeply touched that they remembered my cat's name just from me mentioning my last name over the phone.

It's been over seven years since I transferred here.
I trust them very much because they explain everything in detail and tell me their honest opinions.
Pets are living creatures, so all sorts of things can happen, but they always help me with appropriate advice.
